notes:
BUILD 23
- Industrial Turrets: armoured, four barrels, three times an auto turret's health, faster fire, harder hits, longer reach. Explosives or a lot of rifle rounds.
- Arms Depot is harder: six industrial turrets (two on the vault door, two on the gate, two on the flanks), six more heavies in the yard.
- The Vault: a new room between the blockhouses behind a Vault Door that takes three C4. Inside: 4 locked crates, 4 gun cases, 2 crates, two heavies and an industrial turret.
- Heavy Helicopter: sent when the Arms Depot or the Large Oil Rig is hit. Three times a patrol helicopter's health and a rocket every nine seconds or so. Only ever one; drops three crates.
- Up to two patrol helicopters can now answer the same call.
- Things to do with scrap at the outpost: a BLACK MARKET panel on the weapon vendor (Thompson to M249, launcher, rockets, C4, tactical hazmat, metal armour, at steep prices) and a SCRAP WHEEL on the parts vendor (bet 25 to 2500; x2, x3, x5, x20 or nothing; the house keeps a few percent).
